First, note:  
- US/Eastern is UTC-5 (no DST in January).  
- Asia/Shanghai is UTC+8.  
- Time difference = UTC+8 − (UTC-5) = +13 hours.  

12 AM January 20, 1005 in US/Eastern → add 13 hours.  
12:00 + 13 hours = 25:00 → 01:00 on January 21, 1005 in Shanghai.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1005-01-21 01:00
